description: Ministry of Labour - The Award made to the Industrial Dispute between H. W. S. C. K. Wijewardena and Bank of Ceylon Head Office (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an industrial dispute arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131. It involves legal proceedings, statutory arbitration processes, and references to specific sections of labor legislation. The content focuses on regulatory compliance and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, land matters, commercial registrations, or other specialized categories.
